title: pvXMLPartitionedHyperTreeGridReader
body:
## pvXMLPartitionedHyperTreeGridReader

Reads partitioned VTK XML hypertree grid data: a .phtg summary file and the .htg piece files it lists, assembled into a hypertree grid (adaptive tree-based AMR mesh). Several summary files form a time series. Use pvHyperTreeGridReader for a single .htg file, which also offers a level limit and a selection box.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The .phtg summary refers to .htg piece files, which must stay with it.
- Many general filters do not accept hypertree grids; convert with pvHyperTreeGridToUnstructuredGrid when needed.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `XMLPartitionedHyperTreeGridReader`. Identity: `sources/XMLPHyperTreeGridReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Each file is expected to be in the partitioned VTK XML phtg data format. The standard extension is .phtg. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvXMLPartitionedHyperTreeGridReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
